name: Fellow
description_en:
Fellow is an AI meeting assistant that captures conversations, produces transcripts and summaries, and organizes follow-up actions. The current product supports bot, botless and in-person capture, with organizational controls for meeting data.

Its governance features and integrations are plan-dependent. Generating useful notes does not guarantee accurate attribution, permission to record or correct automatic updates in another business system.
description_zh:
Fellow 是捕捉对话、生成转录摘要并整理后续行动的 AI 会议助手，当前产品支持机器人、无机器人及现场录制，并提供组织级会议数据控制。

治理功能和集成受套餐约束。有用的笔记不保证归属准确、具有录制许可或其他业务系统中的自动更新正确。

core_features.explanation_zh: 生成转录、会议摘要及候选行动项。

core_features.explanation_en: Recording, retention and sharing controls need plan-specific verification.
core_features.explanation_zh: 录制、保留和分享控制需按套餐确认。

core_features.explanation_en: Query meeting context and prepare follow-up work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 查询会议背景并准备后续工作。

Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Capture options and governed meeting records
sections.title_zh: 录制选项与受管理会议记录
sections.en: The homepage describes capture in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet and in person, transcript/audio/video records, action extraction and Ask Fellow. It lists organization-wide recording policies, access controls and retention settings. These are product-level capabilities, not a promise that every workspace has every control enabled. Confirm capture type and sharing defaults before a sensitive meeting.
sections.zh: 首页介绍 Zoom、Teams、Google Meet 和现场录制，转录音视频记录、行动提取和 Ask Fellow，并列组织录制政策、访问控制及保留设置。这是产品能力，不保证每个工作区都开通全部控制。敏感会议前应确认录制方式和默认分享。

sections.title_en: Example: turn a project review into verified actions
sections.title_zh: 示例：把项目复盘转成核对后的行动项
sections.en: After a pilot project review, compare the transcript with the generated summary and verify each owner and due date against what was actually agreed. Correct ambiguous commitments before sharing or syncing tasks. Include a paused section and check whether the resulting record matches the intended off-record interval. This is a suggested pilot and no meeting was captured here.
sections.zh: 试点项目复盘后，把转录与摘要对照，按实际约定逐条核对负责人和期限。分享或同步任务前，先纠正模糊承诺。加入暂停片段，检查记录是否符合预期的不录制区间。本例是试点建议，本文没有捕捉会议。

sections.title_en: Lifetime Free allowances versus monthly plans
sections.title_zh: Free 终身额度与月度套餐
sections.en: Free lists five AI notes and five AI recordings per user for the lifetime of the account, not five each month. Team lists $7/user/month billed annually or $11 monthly, with ten monthly AI notes. Business lists $15 annually billed or $23 monthly with unlimited notes/recordings; Enterprise lists $25 annually billed and sales contact. The billing FAQ charges active workspace users at the start of the cycle. Verify recording allowance resets, minimum seats and governance rights in the selected plan before purchase.
sections.zh: Free 列每人账户终身五份 AI 笔记和五次 AI 录制，并非每月五次。Team 年付折算每人每月七美元，月付 11 美元，每月十份 AI 笔记。Business 年付折算 15 美元、月付 23 美元，笔记录制不限；Enterprise 列年付折算 25 美元并联系销售。FAQ 按周期开始时的工作区活跃用户计费。购买前需确认录制额度重置、最低席位和治理权益。

sections.title_en: Test permissions as well as transcription
sections.en: Start with a supported meeting setup and a small workspace. Check who can record, who receives the recap and how deletion propagates to integrations. The pricing FAQ notes that Free/trial workspace settings are accessible to all members, while paid settings are restricted to administrators. Fellow may fit shared meeting operations; summaries remain reviewable drafts rather than approved decisions. Source licensing, exact data residency and recovery guarantees were not verified.
sections.zh: 先用受支持会议环境和小工作区，检查谁能录制、谁收摘要及删除如何传到集成。套餐 FAQ 说明 Free 和试用的工作区设置可由所有成员访问，付费版则限管理员。它适合共享会议运营，但摘要仍是待核对草稿，而非已批准决策。源码许可、数据驻留及恢复保证未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify recording reset rules, minimum seats, exact governance entitlements, retention contract and deletion across integrations.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认录制重置、最低席位、治理权益、保留合同及跨集成删除。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
